correctness.rationale: Exact Gaussian posterior-variance inversion yields the displayed rational objective. Exact symbolic derivatives strictly exclude collocation and the right endpoint at every finite variance; conditional covariance excludes the left. Compactness plus uniform negative Hessian at high variance proves unique global optimum; stationarity gives offsets 1/2 and 1/6. Sharp Taylor coefficients 53/18 and 26/9 yield replication regret 1/18. The attached checker independently verifies pivotal algebra and illustrates finite cases; the analytic proof supports universal claims.

value.rationale: The nonlinear two-sensor placement problem has natural path-reconstruction and benchmark motivation. A global strict noncollocation law valid at every finite noise level, followed by a unique high-noise endpoint layer with different offsets 1/2 and 1/6, is structurally informative. The exact 1/(18 eta^3) regret compares against optimally positioned replicated measurements, not a weak fixed baseline. It provides a reproducible benchmark beyond a routine covariance inversion or small numerical example.
